description: Header file declaring functions related to managing the command name hierarchy within a process and environment, including appending command names, retrieving the hierarchy, and releasing resources.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_append_hierarchy
methods.description: Appends the current command name to the environment-maintained hierarchy.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_get_hierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves the command name hierarchy for the current process.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_release
methods.description: Releases resources related to the command name hierarchy.
